== Course of events ==

The misunderstanding sparked by Jellia Jamb's mischievous mistranslation dissolves once The Scarecrow and Jack Pumpkinhead discover that only one language is spoken throughout Oz, revealing that no insult had truly passed between them. With the quarrel exposed as groundless, The Scarecrow declares that he and Jack Pumpkinhead are friends.

Having settled the matter, The Scarecrow leads Jack Pumpkinhead off to play quoits, turning what had been tense exchange into companionable activity.
